# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository contains LeetCode solutions in Java, synced via LeetSync.

## Preferred AI Model
Use the Claude (Anthropic) model (e.g., claude-3-5-sonnet or claude-3-opus) when available for code suggestions and chat.

## Repository Structure
- Each problem has its own directory named `<problem-number>-<problem-slug>/`
- Each directory contains a Java solution file and a `README.md` with the problem description

## Coding Style
- Java solutions following LeetCode's class/method signatures
- Focus on clean, efficient solutions with optimal time and space complexity
